input.question: After World War 2 how did America end up with their economy improved and the rest of the world ended up broke?
input.ground_truth: America didn't get bombed and saw *immense* federal spending that ended the great depression. Also, as it turns out, being the only industrial power that didn't get bombed to hell makes your economy pretty strong as there isn't a whole lot of competition.

Question: After World War 2 how did America end up with their economy improved and the rest of the world ended up broke?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine the world is like a big playground after a big fight (that’s the war). After the fight, America still has lots of toys, building blocks, and candy left because most of the fighting happened far away from their house. Other kids (countries) used up most of their toys and building blocks during the fight.

America helped fix some of the broken toys and gave some to their friends to help them start playing again, but America still had the most toys and building blocks left. That’s why after the big fight, America had lots of stuff to build with, and the other kids didn’t have as much.
